title: SlcConfirmationOutboundV1
description: Outbound SLC enrolment confirmation batch generated by POST /api/v1/regulatory/slc/confirmations/generate. Contains one record per pending enrolment confirmation, withdrawal, or intermission to notify the Student Loans Company of enrolment changes. Transmitted via the SLC Data Exchange service.

confirmations.description: Ordered list of confirmation records. May be empty if no pending confirmations exist.

triggerId.description: Internal downstream trigger ID. Idempotency key: re-transmitting the same triggerId to SLC must be treated as a no-op.

slcReference.description: Student Loans Company customer reference number for this student.

programmeId.description: SRS programme UUID. Null if not linked.

modeOfStudyCode.description: Mode of study at time of confirmation. Values: 'FT' (full-time), 'PT' (part-time).

confirmationType.description: Type of status change to report to SLC.

feeAmount.description: Tuition fee amount as a decimal string (e.g. '9250.00'). Currency is always GBP. Null if not applicable.

expectedEndDate.description: Expected programme end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for open-ended PGR programmes.
